naam: Arm onderdoor reiken – op handen en knieën
pose_en: Man on hands and knees on a mat, seen from the front (his head towards the viewer, slightly from above so both arms are visible). Hands under shoulders, knees under hips, back flat. His RIGHT hand is just lifted off the floor, palm up. One black arrow starts at his right hand and points sideways along the floor, passing under his left arm towards his left side.
eind_en: END position: same front view. His right arm is threaded far under his chest and left arm, lying on the floor palm up and pointing to his left; his right shoulder and the right side of his head rest on the mat; his upper back is clearly rotated; left hand still on the floor with the elbow bent; hips stay above the knees.

naam: Arm heffen – geknield met handen op een bal
pose_en: Man kneeling upright on both knees on a mat, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right). Hips extended so thighs and trunk form one vertical line. A large exercise ball stands on the floor in front of him; both hands rest on top of the ball, elbows slightly bent. One black arrow starts at his right hand on the ball and points forward and up.
eind_en: END position: same side view. His right arm is lifted straight forward to shoulder height, hand open; his left hand still rests on the ball; trunk and hips unchanged, upright and steady.

naam: Nek draaien met hulp van je hand – zittend
pose_en: Man sitting upright on a chair, seen from the front. Head looking straight at the viewer, shoulders level, both hands resting on his thighs. One curved black arrow starts at his chin and points towards his own right shoulder (the viewer's left), showing head rotation.
eind_en: END position: same front view. His head is turned far to his own right so we see his face in profile; the fingers of his left hand rest against the left side of his chin, gently pushing the head a little further; shoulders and trunk still face the viewer.

pose_en: Man lying on his back on a mat, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (his head is at the viewer's right). Knees bent, feet flat, arms beside his body. A small flat pillow under his head, face pointing straight up to the ceiling. One curved black arrow starts at his chin and points up and backwards over the top of his head.
eind_en: END position: same side view. His head is tilted backwards on the pillow so the chin points up and away from the chest and his eyes look to the wall behind him; the back of the head still touches the pillow; shoulders and body unchanged.

pose_en: Man lying on his back on a mat, seen from directly above (top-down view), head at the top of the image. Legs straight, arms beside his body, a small pillow under his head, head in the middle with the nose pointing to the ceiling. One curved black arrow starts at the top of his head and points sideways towards his own right side.
eind_en: END position: same top-down view. His head is tilted sideways so his right ear is close to his right shoulder; the nose still points to the ceiling (no rotation); both shoulders stay low and level.

naam: Curl-up met handen onder de rug – één been gestrekt
pose_en: Man lying on his back on a mat, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (his head is at the viewer's right). His right knee is bent about 90 degrees with the foot flat on the mat; his left leg lies straight on the mat. Both hands are tucked palms-down under the small of his lower back, elbows resting on the mat. Head on the mat. One short black arrow starts at his upper chest and points straight up.
eind_en: END position: same side view. His head and shoulder blades are lifted only a few centimetres off the mat as one block, neck in line with the upper back, eyes to the ceiling; elbows slightly lifted; lower back, hands and legs unchanged.

naam: Kin intrekken met handen op de schouders – staand
pose_en: Man standing upright, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right). Feet hip-width apart. Both hands rest on top of his own shoulders close to the neck (right hand on right shoulder, left hand on left shoulder), fingertips pointing towards his spine, elbows pointing forward and down. Head in a natural, slightly forward position. One black arrow starts at his chin and points horizontally backwards.
eind_en: END position: same side view. His head has glided straight backwards with the chin tucked in (clear double chin), eyes still level; his hands pull the shoulders slightly forward and down; ear is now above the shoulder; trunk stays upright.

naam: Arm en been diagonaal heffen – buiklig
pose_en: Man lying face down on a mat, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (his head is at the viewer's right). Both arms stretched forward on the mat past his head, legs straight, forehead resting on the mat. One black arrow starts at his right hand and points straight up.
eind_en: END position: same side view. His right arm (near side) is lifted straight about 15 cm off the mat and his LEFT leg (far side) is lifted straight about 15 cm off the mat; left arm and right leg stay on the mat; pelvis on the mat; face looking down, head just off the mat.

pose_en: Man standing upright, seen exactly from the side: we see his LEFT side (he faces the viewer's left). Feet together, arms hanging by his sides. One black arrow starts at his left foot and points forward along the floor (a big step forward).
eind_en: END position: same side view. He is in a deep forward lunge: left leg in front with the knee bent about 90 degrees above the ankle, right leg far behind with the knee low and the heel lifted; hips sunk forward and down; his RIGHT arm reaches straight up to the ceiling and slightly over to his left side, trunk long and leaning a little back; left arm hangs by his side.

pose_en: Man standing, seen from the front. Feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent, both hands on his hips, pelvis centred, shoulders level. One curved black arrow starts at his right hip (viewer's left) and circles horizontally around his pelvis, like a hula-hoop movement.
eind_en: END position: same front view. His pelvis is shifted clearly to his own right side (viewer's left) as part of the circle, while head and shoulders stay above the feet; hands still on the hips, knees slightly bent.

naam: Been uitschuiven met aangespannen buik – ruglig
pose_en: Man lying on his back on a mat, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (his head is at the viewer's left, feet at the viewer's right). Both knees bent about 90 degrees, feet flat on the mat, arms beside his body, head on the mat. One black arrow starts at his right heel and points along the mat away from his body.
eind_en: END position: same side view. His right leg (near side) lies fully straight on the mat with the kneecap pointing up; his left knee is still bent with the foot flat; pelvis level and lower back unchanged.

naam: Bekken optrekken – staand op een verhoging
pose_en: Man standing on a low step, seen from the front. His left foot (viewer's right) stands on the step with the knee straight; his right leg hangs straight down beside the step, the right foot lower than the step surface so the right side of the pelvis is dropped. His left hand lightly holds a rail. One black arrow starts at his right hip and points straight up.
eind_en: END position: same front view. The right side of his pelvis is hiked up clearly higher than the left, so the hanging right foot is now above the level of the step; both knees straight; shoulders level and trunk upright.

naam: Kin intrekken – buiklig met hoofd over de rand
pose_en: Man lying face down on a bed or treatment table, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (his head is at the viewer's right). His shoulders are at the edge and his head hangs slightly down past the edge, face towards the floor; arms beside his body, legs straight. One black arrow starts at the back of his head and points straight up towards the ceiling.
eind_en: END position: same side view. His head is lifted so the neck is in one straight horizontal line with his back, chin tucked in (double chin), face still pointing straight down to the floor; no backward bending of the neck; body unchanged.

pose_en: Man lying on his back on a mat, seen from directly above (top-down view), head at the top of the image. Both legs straight and together, heels level, toes pointing up, arms beside his body. One black arrow starts at his left heel and points straight down the image, away from his body.
eind_en: END position: same top-down view. His left heel reaches clearly further down than his right heel (exaggerated, about 6 cm), the left side of his pelvis is tilted down and the right side slightly up; both knees straight; shoulders unchanged.

pose_en: Man sitting upright on the front half of a chair, seen from the front. Feet flat and hip-width apart, weight evenly on both buttocks, both hands on his thighs, back not touching the backrest. One black arrow starts at his right hand and points diagonally up and out to his own right side (the viewer's left).
eind_en: END position: same front view. His right arm reaches straight diagonally up and out to his right; his weight is on his right buttock and the left buttock is lifted a few centimetres off the seat, so the pelvis is tilted; trunk long and upright, not leaning forward; left hand on his thigh.

pose_en: Man sitting upright on the front edge of a chair, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right). Feet flat on the floor, hands on his thighs, back straight and well away from the backrest. One black arrow starts at his right buttock on the seat and points backwards towards the backrest.
eind_en: END position: same side view. His right buttock (near side) is lifted slightly off the seat and placed a few centimetres further back than the left, so the pelvis is turned and the right knee sits further back than the left knee; his weight rests on the left buttock; trunk still upright.

pose_en: Man sitting upright on a chair, seen from the front. A resistance band with a small towel as padding runs around the right side of his head just above the ear; both band ends are held taut in his left hand at the level of his left shoulder, so the band pulls horizontally to his own left (the viewer's right). Head upright. One black arrow starts at the top of his head and points towards his own right shoulder (the viewer's left).
eind_en: END position: same front view. His head is tilted sideways to his own right, right ear towards the right shoulder (exaggerated to about 25 degrees), nose still pointing at the viewer; the band is stretched tighter; shoulders level and low.

pose_en: Man in a forearm plank on his knees on a mat, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (his head is at the viewer's right). Forearms flat on the mat with elbows directly under the shoulders, knees on the mat, lower legs bent slightly up, hips lifted so that knees, hips and shoulders form one straight line; neck in line, eyes to the floor. One short black arrow starts under his belly and points straight up, showing that the hips are held up.
eind_en: END position: same side view. The same held position: straight line from knees to shoulders, abdomen tight, hips neither sagging nor piked.

pose_en: Man in a kneeling push-up position on a mat, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (his head is at the viewer's right). Arms straight with hands under the shoulders, knees on the mat, lower legs bent slightly up, one straight line from knees through hips to head. One black arrow starts at his chest and points straight down to the mat.
eind_en: END position: same side view. His elbows are bent to about 90 degrees and his chest hovers just above the mat; the body is still one straight line from knees to head; neck in line.

pose_en: Man in an incline push-up position, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right). Both hands on the edge of a sturdy bench about knee height, arms straight, feet on the floor behind him on the toes, body one straight inclined line from heels to head. One black arrow starts at his chest and points diagonally down towards the bench.
eind_en: END position: same side view. His elbows are bent to about 90 degrees and his chest is close to the edge of the bench; body still one straight line from heels to head, hips not sagging.

pose_en: Man sitting slumped on a chair, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right). His back is rounded, chin dropped to his chest, hands clasped loosely behind his lower back; both knees bent 90 degrees, feet on the floor. One black arrow starts at his right foot and points forward and up (knee straightening).
eind_en: END position: same side view. His right knee (near side) is straightened so the lower leg is almost horizontal, with the toes pulled back towards the shin; at the same time his head is lifted and he looks straight ahead; his back is still rounded; left foot on the floor.

naam: Voet optillen – zittend op een bal
pose_en: Man sitting upright on a large exercise ball, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right). Hips and knees bent about 90 degrees, both feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, hands on his hips, spine tall and neutral. One black arrow starts at his right knee and points straight up.
eind_en: END position: same side view. His right foot (near side) is lifted about 10 cm off the floor with the knee still bent; left foot flat on the floor; trunk upright and pelvis level, not leaning back or sideways; the ball has not moved.
